You can close this wizard at any time and open it again later.

Files is where you view and manage everything you store.

You will find it in the apps menu (top left) — together with Calendar, Mail, Contacts and more. Click the menu any time to switch apps.

With the search bar you can quickly find files, contacts and more.

Just type what you're looking for and press Enter.

Click it whenever you want to adjust your account.

Nextcloud is your personal cloud storage!

Here you can:

  • 📁 Upload, share and collaborate on files
  • 📅 Manage your calendar
  • ✉️ Send and receive email
  • 👥 Keep track of contacts
translations.<p><strong>Finding your way around:</str:
Finding your way around:

  • Use the apps menu (top left) to switch between apps
  • Open your avatar (top right) for your account and settings
  • Use the search bar to quickly find files and more

Did you know:

  • You can upload files by dragging them to your browser
  • You can directly share files with a link
  • You can also use Nextcloud as an app on your phone
  • All your data is stored privately and securely

translations.Interactive onboarding tour for new Next: Interactive onboarding tour for new Nextcloud users
translations.IntroVox provides a user-friendly guided:
IntroVox provides a user-friendly guided tour that helps new users get started with Nextcloud.

**Features:**
* Interactive step-by-step tour through Nextcloud's main features
* Full admin interface for customising tour steps per language
* Multi-language support via Transifex (every translated language is automatically available)
* Import/export functionality for easy tour configuration sharing
* Global enable/disable control for administrators
* Per-language admin overrides for custom tour copy
* Group-based visibility for individual steps
* Personal settings for users to restart or permanently disable the tour
* Admin statistics dashboard with wizard usage metrics
* Optional anonymous telemetry reporting
* Automatically adapts to your Nextcloud theme (light, dark, high contrast)
* Privacy-focused: tour completion status stored locally

**Perfect for:**
* Nextcloud administrators who want to improve user onboarding
* Organisations deploying Nextcloud to new users
* Multi-language organisations with diverse user bases
* Anyone who wants to help users discover Nextcloud features

Built with Vue 3 and Shepherd.js for a smooth, modern user experience.
